questions: When you pull your skin like that, does it snap back into place immediately, or does it stay loose and slowly retract?
Have you ever had joints that dislocate easily or been told you are "double-jointed"?
Do you bruise very easily or have scars that look wide and paper-thin?
Have you ever been told you have a heart murmur or have you ever had a leaky valve?
Do you ever get dizzy when you stand up quickly, or feel like you might faint?
Have you ever had a hernia, like a bulge in your groin or belly?
When did you first notice your skin was like this - has it always been stretchy, or did it change and become loose over time?
Have you ever taken the antibiotic minocycline or any medication for rheumatoid arthritis like penicillamine?
Do you have any shortness of breath, or have you ever been told you have lung problems like emphysema?
Has your skin always been like this since you were young, or did it start to get loose as you got older?
Do you have similar loose skin on your neck, face, or underarms?
Have you experienced any rapid weight loss recently?
Do you have any history of a rash, pimple, or bug bite on your belly before the skin became loose?
Do you have any family members with similar skin findings?
Have you ever had any autoimmune conditions like lupus or thyroid problems?

dx_raw:
ORDER:
1. Skin punch biopsy with elastin stain (Verhoeff-Van Gieson) of the affected abdominal skin to assess elastic fiber architecture
2. Pulmonary function tests to screen for associated emphysema

DIAGNOSIS: Acquired cutis laxa, localized to abdomen, likely idiopathic, characterized by loss of dermal elastic fibers
